known_boundaries: Only Gregorian civil input is accepted by calc_chart.py
Place and timezone are recorded but no solar-time or DST conversion is performed
Minute precision is preserved, but disputed true-solar-time and alternate day-boundary schools are not resolved
Five-element counts are unweighted stem plus branch-primary counts
Bazi strength, pattern, and useful-god conclusions remain human-audited traditional inferences rather than engine facts
Bazi flow years output deterministic structure only; event interpretation remains conditional
Ziwei annual palace and annual transformation data are NOT_COMPUTED
Narrative consistency is not independent evidence or scientific validation
Rule IDs provide traceability but do not prove a conclusion
